unitTitle: GTU FREQUENT PROGRAMS: SOURCE CODE LABS

details.concept: Fetches exactly 10 space-separated numeric inputs from the runtime execution command line parameters array and runs evaluation logic to isolate the maximum and minimum values.
details.benefits: Enables user data inputs to be processed directly at initial execution time without stalling the system thread for input scanner buffers.
details.keywords: command-line parameters, String args, Integer.parseInt, boundary search

Important Thing Detail.1: args[0] tracks the absolute first inline parameter value passed, up through args[9] matching the tenth digit.
Important Thing Detail.2: Passing input values that contain non-numeric characters will disrupt execution, throwing a runtime NumberFormatException automatically.

  Args -->|Loop Parsing| Logic["Min/Max Comparison Engine"]

details.concept: Initializes an integer collection and executes a double-nested sorting routine to iteratively swap adjacent elements into ascending sequential order.
details.benefits: Arranges chaotic data values into an indexed structure, preparing arrays for high-performance retrieval configurations like binary searches.
details.keywords: bubble sort, nested loops, array index, temporary swap

Important Thing Detail.1: The dynamic comparison limit (arr.length - 1 - i) avoids redundant passes over sorted items.
Important Thing Detail.2: A 'temp' placeholder variable is mandatory to preserve array data values securely while swapping indices.

details.concept: Executes tracking loops to generate mathematical patterns. The Fibonacci logic adds two previous values to form the next term, while digits sum extracts trailing digits via remainder divisions.
details.benefits: Develops optimized variable modifications and iteration logic using mathematical operations.
details.keywords: Fibonacci, numeric sum, modulus operator, truncation loop

Important Thing Detail.1: The modulus operator (%) isolates the last digit by returning the remainder of a division by 10.
Important Thing Detail.2: Integer division (num /= 10) shifts values to the right by stripping away the last digit.

details.concept: Extends the base Exception superclass to define an application-specific error checking rule. The method manually signals violations with the throw keyword, while the calling method catches it using a try-catch block.
details.benefits: Protects core enterprise logic by isolating invalid business data before it corrupts downstream processing threads.
details.keywords: user-defined error, super call, explicit throw, exception handling model

Important Thing Detail.1: Custom exceptions must inherit from java.lang.Exception to be tracked by the compiler as checked exceptions.
Important Thing Detail.2: The throws clause is required in the method signature to warn callers about the potential custom error.
Important Thing Detail.3: The error message is passed to the parent Exception class using super(msg) and retrieved via getMessage().

details.concept: Opens an 8-bit raw byte channel using FileOutputStream to save data into a file, then initializes a FileInputStream channel to read characters back into the application.
details.benefits: Ensures simple persistence data operations, saving state attributes onto disk memory storage blocks permanently.
details.keywords: FileOutputStream, FileInputStream, file read, write byte, file handling

Important Thing Detail.1: The read() method returns a value of -1 when it hits the end-of-file boundary marker.
Important Thing Detail.2: Closing streams explicitly via close() is required to free underlying operating system file descriptor references.
